units.source_text: 且说那位落叶公主，一直笼闭在储藏室中。

en.t: Now Princess Ochiba had remained shut away in the storeroom all this time.

units.source_text: 众侍女劝道：“公主终不成一辈子住在这里面。

en.t: Her ladies urged her, saying, "Your Highness cannot spend your whole life in here.

units.source_text: 外人听到了，要讥笑公主太孩子气，行事不成体统。

en.t: If people outside hear of it, they will laugh that you are childish and behaving improperly.

units.source_text: 还不如到外边来，照常起居，把公主的主意向大将说明吧。”

en.t: It would be better to come out, live as usual, and explain your wishes to the Captain."

units.source_text: 此外又做种种劝导。

en.t: They also tried many other ways to persuade her.

units.source_text: 公主觉得这些话也有道理。

en.t: The princess felt that there was some reason in what they said.

units.source_text: 然而想起今后外间流传恶名，以及过去自心种种痛苦，

en.t: Yet when she thought of the disgrace that would spread outside from now on, and of all the suffering she had endured in her heart,

units.source_text: 都由这个可恨的不良之人而来，

en.t: all of it had come from this hateful and unworthy man,

units.source_text: 这天晚上又不肯和他会面。

en.t: and that night she again refused to meet him.

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“开玩笑也不是这样开的，真是少有少见的啊！”

en.t: Yugiri said, "Even a joke should not be carried this far. This is truly something rare and strange!"

units.source_text: 他大发牢骚。

en.t: He complained bitterly.

units.source_text: 众侍女也都代他委屈，对他说道：“公主说过：‘再过几时，

en.t: The ladies felt sorry for him too, and said to him, "The princess has said, 'After a little more time has passed,

units.source_text: 等我身心恢复健康之后，如果他还不忘记，

en.t: when my body and mind have recovered, if he still has not forgotten me,

units.source_text: 我总会向他致意。

en.t: I will certainly send him my greetings.

units.source_text: 在此丧服之中，让我一心不乱地专诚为亡母超度吧。’

en.t: While I am still in mourning, please let me devote myself single-mindedly to prayers for my late mother.'

units.source_text: 她的心很坚决。

en.t: Her mind is firmly made up.

units.source_text: 大将频频来访，深恐外间无人不知，公主也非常担心呢。”

en.t: Because the Captain visits so often, she fears everyone outside will know, and she is very anxious about it."

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“我的用心与别人不同，决不做非礼之行，想不到如此受人冷遇！”

en.t: Yugiri replied, "My intentions are different from other men's, and I would never act improperly. I never expected to be treated so coldly!"

units.source_text: 他长叹一声，又说：“只要公主肯在日常起居室中接见我，隔着屏幕也好。

en.t: He sighed deeply and went on, "If only the princess would receive me in her ordinary living room, even from behind a screen.

units.source_text: 我只指望把心事诉说一番，决不违反公主之意。

en.t: I only hope to speak my heart once, and I will never go against her wishes.

units.source_text: 叫我等待多少年月，都无不可。”

en.t: If she tells me to wait for any number of months or years, I will do so."

units.source_text: 他再三要求，絮聒不休。

en.t: He begged again and again, talking on without end.

units.source_text: 公主命侍女答道：“我已困顿不堪，你还要无理强求，实在太狠心了。

en.t: The princess ordered a lady to answer, "I am already exhausted beyond bearing, and still you press me unreasonably. It is truly heartless.

units.source_text: 世间谣诼纷传，我身不幸已极，这且不说。

en.t: Rumors are spreading everywhere, and my misfortune is already at its limit, but let that pass.

units.source_text: 你又如此用心，怎不教人痛恨！”

en.t: When you persist in such intentions, how could I not feel bitter hatred?"

units.source_text: 她越发讨厌夕雾，只想远而避之。

en.t: She came to dislike Yugiri all the more and wanted only to keep far away from him.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“只管如此下去，被外人闻知了确也难听。

en.t: Yugiri thought, "If this simply goes on like this, it will certainly sound bad if outsiders hear of it.

units.source_text: 叫这些侍女看了也不好意思。”

en.t: It is embarrassing even to have these ladies see me like this."

units.source_text: 便催促传言的小少将君道：“实际关系，一定遵照公主所言。

en.t: So he urged Ko-shosho, who was carrying the messages, saying, "As for our actual relationship, I will certainly follow the princess's wishes.

units.source_text: 但在目前，暂做表面夫妇吧。

en.t: But for the present, let us be husband and wife in appearance only.

units.source_text: 如此有名无实，真乃世间怪相。

en.t: To have the name without the reality like this is truly a strange state of affairs.

units.source_text: 再说，倘因公主坚拒，而我断绝访问，则外人将谓公主被弃，

en.t: Besides, if I stop visiting because the princess firmly refuses me, people will say that she has been abandoned,

units.source_text: 更加有损令名。

en.t: and that will damage her good name even more.

units.source_text: 总之，固执一念，像孩子一般不明事理，实在令人遗憾！”

en.t: In short, for her to cling stubbornly to one idea and fail to understand reason like a child is truly regrettable!"

units.source_text: 小少将君认为夕雾之言有理。

en.t: Ko-shosho thought there was reason in what Yugiri said.

units.source_text: 她看看夕雾的模样，但见他此时的确痛苦，觉得万分抱歉。

en.t: She looked at Yugiri and saw that he was truly suffering at that moment, and she felt deeply sorry for him.

units.source_text: 便把侍女进出的储藏室北门打开，放他进去。

en.t: So she opened the north door of the storeroom, the one the ladies used to go in and out, and let him enter.
